name: vi-history-suite
description: VS Code extension for content-detected LabVIEW VI history review in Git repositories.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: VI History disables background indexing and external LabVIEW comparison-tool execution in untrusted workspaces.

viHistorySuite.strictRsrcHeader.description: When enabled, require the leading RSRC CRLF bytes in addition to LVIN/LVCC at offset 8.

viHistorySuite.maxIndexedConcurrency.description: Maximum concurrent eligibility checks during repository indexing.

viHistorySuite.historyWindowMode.description: How the VI History panel chooses its retained commit window. Auto loads the full file history when it fits within the automatic safety ceiling; capped uses the explicit maxHistoryEntries limit.

viHistorySuite.maxHistoryEntries.description: Explicit retained-commit ceiling when historyWindowMode is capped.

viHistorySuite.labviewExePath.description: Optional explicit path to the preferred LabVIEW executable.

viHistorySuite.windowsContainerImage.description: Preferred Windows LabVIEW container image for isolated 64-bit comparison-report execution.

viHistorySuite.preferBitness.description: Preferred LabVIEW bitness when both x86 and x64 are installed.

scripts.docs:workbench:gate: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/workspace -w /workspace vi-history-suite-docs-authoring:local npm run docs:gate
scripts.harness:decision:record: npm run compile && node out/cli/runHarnessDecisionRecord.js --harness-id HARNESS-VHS-001 --reviewer Codex --review-question "Does the concentrated evidence support bounded review completion?" --outcome needs-more-review --confidence medium --decision-rationale "The dashboard is evidence-rich, but the reviewer should still verify whether more manual inspection is needed."
scripts.harness:smoke: npm run compile && node out/cli/runHarnessSmoke.js --harness-id HARNESS-VHS-001
scripts.harness:report:smoke: npm run compile && node out/cli/runHarnessReportSmoke.js --harness-id HARNESS-VHS-001
scripts.harness:dashboard:smoke: npm run compile && node out/cli/runHarnessDashboardSmoke.js --harness-id HARNESS-VHS-001
scripts.preview:refresh: npm run package && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const p=require('./package.json'); const name=p.name+'-'+p.version+'.vsix'; fs.copyFileSync(name, 'preview-evidence/'+name); fs.copyFileSync(name, '/mnt/c/Users/sveld/Downloads/'+name); console.log('Refreshed '+name);"
scripts.test:integration: npm run compile && npm run test:integration:compile && node out-tests/tests/integration/runTests.js
scripts.package: npm run compile && npm run package:audit && node scripts/runPinnedVsce.js package
